title: He Treated Her Like a Housewife. She Built His Empire.
description: He spent years treating her like an empty-headed trophy wife, completely unaware that every major deal he closed was pulled off behind the scenes by her. But when he pushes her too far, she pulls the plug on his entire company and shows him who really runs the show. Get ready for the ultimate payback when he realizes he just threw away the real billionaire.
